items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I had Mingus in the band there

ctx.x: No, he owned it when I was there, and what's the girl who was the singer with one of the bands -- Anita O'Day played there, and as I said, Frankie Lane and Billy Eckstine was there. They had all the -- and Mingus was playing there with me. I had Mingus in the band there, and I never will forget; Billy is out on the floor doing "Old Man River", and Mingus used to love to bow his bass, you know.

And so Billy's trying to sing, people all singing the verse of the thing, and back in the back, Mingus is sawing on this thing -- he's gonna do a concerto on it, you know. And Billy just turned around and said, "Put the spotlight on him!"
